summary: Frontend-only validation of the new Admin GTFS panel on /admin/transport. All 3 scenarios pass: panel renders at top with non-empty last-import date and 3 network cards (Centre 1373 arrêts·152701 horaires, Maritime 5·426, Nord 1951·77226); 'Rafraîchir maintenant' click triggers a refresh and displays the expected toast 'GTFS déjà à jour (aucune nouvelle version)' with dates unchanged; regression CRUD tabs (Arrêts 10 / Lignes 4) remain fully functional below the panel.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminTransport.js (~305 lines) — clean, single-file ok for now but starts to be dense; could split GTFS panel into its own component if it grows.
refreshGtfs catches errors silently with a generic toast — acceptable, but a future improvement could surface the underlying error code/message for admin troubleshooting.
loadGtfs swallows exceptions silently with '/* ignore */' — fine for non-blocking status, but a console.warn would help debugging if the endpoint regresses.
seed_data_creation: None. Used pre-existing GTFS Martinique meta (3 feeds populated, 3329 total stops).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin login flow: /login/email -> [data-testid=email-input/password-input/email-login-submit-btn]. After login, admin lands on /admin; navigate to /admin/transport. The GTFS panel is rendered above the Arrêts/Lignes tabs. Toast library is sonner — toasts may use [data-sonner-toast] but in this run no toast DOM node was returned by querySelector; the toast text was verified visually via screenshot (top-right of viewport). When asserting toasts programmatically, prefer page.get_by_text('GTFS déjà à jour') with a short timeout rather than a generic selector.
